    • buildBoardScreen

      private javafx.scene.layout.BorderPane buildBoardScreen(javafx.stage.Stage stage, GameManager manager)
      Builds the Clue board contains the buttons needed for the game start turn, roll dice, make accusation Shows basic info like current player, dice number rolled NOTE: There are some stylistic elements in this method that were AI generated (setting font/background color, size)
      Parameters:
      stage - passes the main application window to this method
      manager - a GameManager (manages the overall clue game logic)
      Returns:
      a BorderPane containing main game layout, with a menu (at the top, with buttons) and the game at the center

    • launchSuggestionFlow

      private void launchSuggestionFlow(Player suggestingPlayer, Room room)
      The method that starts the suggestion flow Creates this in a new empty window, seperate from the main board Uses the method from GameManager, findDisprovingPlayer, which finds first player who can disprove a suggestion and getDisprovingCards, which gets all cards the disproving player is able to disprove suggestion with Uses wrapUpTurn(), helper method NOTE: There are some stylistic elements in this method that were AI generated (like setting font/background color, size)
      Parameters:
      suggestingPlayer - the player who is suggesting
      room - the room the player is in
